projects.name: ghostrun
projects.status: Live, actively growing (27 stars, 5 forks as of Oct 2026 — newest project, strongest infra-depth signal)
projects.problemSolved: Testing LLM apps traditionally means repeated paid API calls (slow, expensive) and flaky exact-match assertions on non-deterministic outputs.
keyFeatures: Record/replay system: wraps tests with @ghostrun.record, caches API responses on first run, replays offline in ~0.04s afterward — fully offline CI runs.
Semantic assertions (e.g. ghostrun.expect(reply).tone_is("empathetic")) graded by a local Ollama judge instead of brittle string matching — no cloud dependency, private by default.
Prompt optimization engine (`ghostrun craft`): Bayesian search over few-shot examples and instructions given an input/output signature and criterion.
Regression tracking (`ghostrun diff`) with CI integration (JUnit, PR comments); majority-vote judge caching for reliability.
Multi-provider support: 16+ HTTP providers including OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, AWS Bedrock.
Pure pytest integration — no custom harness or YAML config; published on PyPI with OIDC trusted publishing.
highlights: pytest-native testing framework for AI applications: deterministic replay of LLM calls for fast, free, offline test runs.
Replaces flaky exact-match assertions with semantic judgments via a local judge model, and auto-optimizes failing prompts via Bayesian search.

Infra/tooling project (not a demo) addressing a real, well-known pain point in LLM app development (flaky/expensive tests) — the strongest evidence in the whole profile of systems/infra-level thinking rather than API wrapping.
Organic traction (27 stars, 5 forks) within weeks of launch, with no marketing push.

projects.name: Saarthi AI — Proactive Commute-Planning Agent
projects.status: Complete, demo-ready autonomous multi-tool agent system
projects.problemSolved: Standard mapping apps react to current conditions, not future ones — doesn't answer "when should I leave, and what local disruptions should I worry about" for Lucknow-specific factors (religious processions, festival congestion, police diversions).
keyFeatures: Simulates multiple future departure windows via TomTom's departAt sweep, building an ETA risk curve instead of a single estimate.
Multi-signal risk fusion: traffic, weather, local festivals/events, police advisories combined into a transparent 0-100 risk score before LLM narration.
Persistent agent memory in MongoDB Atlas with MCP tool access — agent can query/reason over historical commute patterns.
Agent layer built on Google ADK's LlmAgent with tool-calling orchestration (route/weather/festival tools + MongoDB find/aggregate/list-collections via MCP).
Degradation safety: caching, fallback LLM provider (Groq), deterministic summaries if APIs fail.

highlights: Full agentic system (not a chatbot wrapper): multi-tool orchestration, persistent memory, transparent risk scoring, and multi-provider LLM fallback.
Autonomous multi-tool agent using Google ADK, Gemini, and MongoDB MCP with automated fallback routing for resilient execution.
